description: One node in a scene file. A set with properties {"name": "Boss"} renames a node. A rename or a reparent rewrites the paths naming the node, here and in the scenes instancing or inheriting this one. That saves an animation library kept in a .tres of its own. A delete rewrites none. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: add (needs nodeName): a node of class nodeType, or an instance of the scene at instancePath; get (needs nodePath): read a node's class, properties and where its values come from, and a TileMap's cells; set (needs nodePath): set properties, groups, editableChildren or placeholder on a node, any together; duplicate (needs nodePath, newName): copy a node and its children, right after it or under parentNodePath; reparent (needs nodePath, newParentPath): move a node under another parent, or among its siblings; delete (needs nodePath); change_type (needs nodePath, nodeType): make a node another class that keeps its name, children, script and matching values; save_branch (needs nodePath, newScenePath): a node and its children become a scene of their own, instanced in their place; set_tilemap_cells (needs nodePath, cells): place tiles in a TileMapLayer or TileMap; bake_navigation (needs nodePath): bake a NavigationRegion2D or 3D from the geometry under it, into the scene or the navigation resource's own file, which every scene using it shares.

addGroups.description: Groups to put the node in. For ops add, set.

cells.description: Cells to place. A cell named twice takes its last entry. For op set_tilemap_cells.

atlasCoords.description: The tile in the source. Not needed to erase.

sourceId.description: TileSet source id, or -1 to erase the cell.

editableChildren.description: On an instance of another scene: whether its children are editable here. False drops the values and nodes added below it. For op set.

includeDefaults.description: Include properties still at their default. Default false. For op get.

index.description: Where the node goes among the parent's children, 0 for first. Default last, or right after the original for a copy under its parent. For ops add, duplicate, reparent.

instancePath.description: A scene to instance instead of a class, such as "ui/panel.tscn". For op add.

keepGlobalTransform.description: Default true: the node stays where it is drawn, as in the editor, and a Control keeps its position only. false keeps the node's own transform. For op reparent.

layer.description: The layer of a TileMap. Default 0. A TileMapLayer is one layer. For op set_tilemap_cells.

newName.description: The copy's name. The copy has the original's children and their connections. For op duplicate.

newParentPath.description: The new parent, which may be the one it has, to move it among its siblings. For op reparent.

newScenePath.description: Where the new scene goes, such as "props/crate.tscn". An existing file is refused. For op save_branch.

nodeName.description: The new node's name. For op add.

nodePath.description: Node path from the scene root, such as "Player/Sprite2D". "." is the root. Not for op add.

nodeType.description: The node class, such as "CharacterBody2D", or a declared class_name. For ops add, change_type.

parentNodePath.description: add: where the node goes. Default the root. duplicate: where the copy goes. For ops add, duplicate.

placeholder.description: With instancePath on add, or on set for an instance: save it as a placeholder. For ops add, set.

properties.description: Properties to set, keyed by Godot name. Vectors are {"x": 1, "y": 2} or, as a read answers, {"_type": "Vector2", "x": 1, "y": 2}. A colour may be "#ff8000", an enum takes its name, "position:x" sets one component. A node property takes a path such as "../Player", a Resource property a res:// path or {"_type": "CircleShape2D", "radius": 8}. A map keyed by anything but text is {"_type": "Dictionary", "entries": [[key, value]]}. A whole number of 2^53 or more is {"_type": "int", "value": "9007199254740993"}. A "metadata/" key adds metadata, and null takes it off. A slash path such as "sources/0/0:0/0/probability" writes inside a built-in resource. For ops add, set.

removeGroups.description: Groups to take the node out of. One it is not in is refused. For op set.

unset.description: Properties to remove from this scene's file, such as "modulate". Each then takes the value its source gives. An editor's next save writes an unset shader parameter back. For op set.

name: scene_node
title: Scene nodes
